reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web side panel for session-scoped Markdown drafting, previewing, copying, and AI-assisted full-draft or selected-text rewriting without modifying workspace files.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供会话级 Markdown 写作板，支持编辑、预览、复制以及完整草稿和选中文本的 AI 改写。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web side panel for session-scoped Markdown editing, previewing, copying, and AI-assisted full-draft or selected-text rewriting.

capabilities: Provides a session-scoped Markdown writing and preview panel
Sends draft and selected-text rewrite requests to the host model
Stores draft state temporarily in host memory
Restores drafts and pending review candidates from recorded writing requests and tool results
